parts:
Hi, 

Shiny if great! Thanks RStudio folks. 

I'm designing an app where I let users upload a file and then they see results of the analysis in the main panel. I'm hoping to be able to store this data and do further analysis on all the data so that the new users can also see more results e.g. how their data compares to other users. I'm not hoping to use more than a few GBs of space as the uploaded files will be small text files. And I'm not thinking to run it indefinitely or commercialize it. 
Thanks
